ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hours. Field expedition to Costa Rica over spring break (approx. 9 days), and weekly seminar. The course will use Costa Rica as a case study to examine environment and sustainability issues. Topics includes: rainforest ecology, land-use issues, sustainable agriculture, global versus local economies, and geologic features of the landscape (e.g., volcanoes; rivers). Restricted to ESE majors; non-ESE majors in LAS can apply to the waitlist (email anesbitt@illinois.edu). LAS students will be responsible for the field trip expenses in the amount of $2600. If you are an eligible student and you are having problems registering, please contact holben@illinois.edu. Restricted to Earth Systems, Env, & Society or Earth, Society, & Environment majors(s).
